guards.name: windows-local-commander
guards.description: Native MCP bridge exposed to ChatGPT via Tailscale Funnel (http://127.0.0.1:8765). Delegates healing to its own idempotent START.cmd, which already owns pid checks and an elevated watchdog. No identity block: its processes run elevated, so a non-elevated AgentGuard cannot read their command line (fail-closed by design) and does not need to - the delegate never kills.
